description: This file is a FastAPI route module that defines endpoints for managing multiplayer Tic Tac Toe games. It includes functionalities for creating, joining, leaving, playing moves, and retrieving game state. It manages game state transitions, user authentication via cookies, and game logic such as move validation and winner determination.

methods.name: get_current_user(request: Request, db: Session)
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on request cookies.

methods.name: create_game(_: GameCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new game instance and adds the creator as the first player.

methods.name: join_game(body: GameJoin, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing waiting game.

methods.name: leave_game(body: GameLeave, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Removes a user from a game they are participating in.

methods.name: play_move(body: MoveCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Processes a move made by a player, updating game state and checking for a winner or draw.

methods.name: get_game(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific game by ID.

methods.name: _find_winner(board)
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner on the current board.

methods.name: _to_game_read(game, db, players=None)
methods.description: Transforms game ORM object into a serialized GameRead object with associated data.
